wins: Every Ally that enters triggers the others: Avatar Enthusiasts grow, South Pole Voyager gains life and draws. Go wide, then fly over with Aang, Appa and Yip Yip!
plan: Earth Kingdom Protectors, Momo, South Pole Voyager, Invasion Reinforcements (flash, two bodies).
Avatar Enthusiasts and Kyoshi Warriors grow the team; Earth Kingdom Jailer exiles a 3+ mana threat; Suki pumps all your creatures.
Aang and Appa in the air, Yip Yip! gives an Ally +2/+2 and flying, United Front makes X Allies and pumps everything.
keys: Gain 1 life on each Ally entering; the second trigger in a turn draws a card.
A +1/+1 counter every time another Ally enters.
+1/+0 to your other creatures, and a new Ally whenever a permanent of yours leaves during your turn.
Late-game finisher: X tokens and a counter on every creature.
tips: Play two Allies in one turn when you can: Voyager draws on its second trigger.
Invasion Reinforcements has flash: cast it at the end of the opponent’s turn or as a surprise blocker.
Earth Kingdom Protectors sacrifices to make another Ally indestructible: save your best creature from removal.
Airbend (Aang, Appa) exiles a permanent; its owner can recast it for 2. Use it to reset an opponent’s threat or reuse your own enters triggers.
Razor Rings only hits an attacking or blocking creature.
mulligan: Keep 2–4 Plains with two or more cheap Allies.
